title: fix(console): mock react-map-gl/maplibre by its bare specifier in the filter-token sweep (objectui#10731)
body:
Fixes #10731
Clause-②: no — a test's mock specifier and a devDependency of @object-ui/console, which no consumer installs; no published surface moves

The main-red anchor for the `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check`. objectui#10732 (the twin filing, closed as this card's duplicate) is folded in here: same check, same site, same origin (PR objectui#10729, card objectui#10666). Triage `5852234038` direction 1 is taken; direction 2 was not needed because direction 1 passed its resolved-id check.

## What changed

- `apps/console/src/__tests__/filterContextTokensSweep-10666.test.tsx`: the WebGL stub for `plugin-map`'s `ObjectMap` now reads `vi.mock('react-map-gl/maplibre', …)`, the bare specifier `ObjectMap` itself imports and the spelling every `plugin-map` test uses. The comment above it states the real reason (vitest keys a mock on the RESOLVED module id; the app must resolve the same file `plugin-map` resolves) and records why the previous relative path into `packages/plugin-map/node_modules` went red pre-install. The factory's five stubs are unchanged.
- `apps/console/package.json`: one devDependency, `"react-map-gl": "^8.1.2"`, the SAME range `packages/plugin-map/package.json` declares.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`: regenerated by `pnpm install`, never by hand. The whole diff is the one importer entry under `apps/console` (3 added lines: `react-map-gl`, `specifier: ^8.1.2`, `version: 8.1.2(maplibre-gl@6.4.1)(react-dom@19.2.8(react@19.2.8))(react@19.2.8)`). No new package entry: the store already held exactly that instance for `plugin-map`.
- `.changeset/10731-console-map-mock-bare-specifier.md`: empty frontmatter (nothing released), because `check-changeset-presence` counts `apps/console/src/**` and asked for a declaration.

Not done, on purpose: no allow-list entry, no change to `scripts/check-vi-mock-specifiers.mjs` or to `.github/workflows/vi-mock-specifiers.yml`.

## H1 — the red reproduced, then the green

No-install worktree at `origin/main` `ee6f6c6a45` (no `node_modules` anywhere), `node scripts/check-vi-mock-specifiers.mjs`, exit 1:

```
❌  check-vi-mock-specifiers: 1 mock resolves to no file on disk
    - apps/console/src/__tests__/filterContextTokensSweep-10666.test.tsx -- vi.mock("../../../../packages/plugin-map/node_modules/react-map-gl/dist/maplibre.js")
      tried 24 path(s), first: PATH_OF_WORKTREE/packages/plugin-map/node_modules/react-map-gl/dist/maplibre.js
```

(The gate prints the line address after the file name; it is left out of this body under AGENTS.md #11.) The same tree after `pnpm install`: exit 0, `check-vi-mock-specifiers: OK (5622 tracked source file(s), 3794 test-named; 857 carry a mock; 1191 relative specifier(s) resolved, 1234 bare (out of scope), …)`. So the red is a pre-install artifact of a specifier that names a `node_modules` path — the job runs the checker right after `setup-node`, with no install.

## H2 — is the mock load-bearing, and was it installed at runtime?

Both measured in the installed worktree at `origin/main`, before any edit:

- **Installed at runtime, yes.** A throwaway sentinel file (never committed) mocked the SAME relative specifier with a `Map` stub that renders `data-testid="sentinel-10731"`, rendered `object-map` through the real `SchemaRenderer` and `plugin-map`'s registration, and asserted the sentinel is in the DOM. Run together with the sweep: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 73 passed (73)`. Vite resolves the relative path to the store's real path, which is also where `plugin-map`'s import lands, so the mock matched. The runtime mock was never inert; only the pre-install gate could not see the file.
- **Load-bearing, yes.** With the whole `vi.mock` block deleted (on-disk proof: `vi.mock(` count 1 → 0, `react-map-gl` mentions 1 → 0, `git diff --stat` 12 deletions), the sweep went red: `Tests 1 failed | 71 passed (72)`, the failing cell `'object-map (inline)' > CONTROL: a token-free filter reaches the query unchanged`, with the real `maplibre-gl` crashing on unmount in happy-dom — `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'destroy')` from `maplibre-gl/src/ui/map.ts` via `@vis.gl/react-maplibre`. Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- FILE`, blob `d387d2a1c0…` equal to HEAD's, `git status` clean. The card's "drop it if the suite does not need it" arm is therefore closed: the suite needs the stub.

## H3 — direction 1, with the resolved-id proof

- `react-map-gl` added to `apps/console` devDependencies at `^8.1.2`; `pnpm install` (29.7 s, warm store) rewrote the lockfile by the one importer entry quoted above.
- Same real path: `realpath apps/console/node_modules/react-map-gl` and `realpath packages/plugin-map/node_modules/react-map-gl` both print `node_modules/.pnpm/react-map-gl@8.1.2_maplibre-gl@6.4.1_react-dom@19.2.8_react@19.2.8__react@19.2.8/node_modules/react-map-gl`; `ls node_modules/.pnpm | grep -c '^react-map-gl@'` is 1. The peer-resolution split the order warned about did not happen: pnpm's default `dedupe-peer-dependents` links the app to the instance that carries the optional `maplibre-gl` peer (`.npmrc` sets `auto-install-peers=true` and nothing overrides the dedupe).
- Vitest-level proof: the sentinel file switched to `vi.mock('react-map-gl/maplibre', …)`, run with the sweep: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 73 passed (73)` — the bare mock is installed from `apps/console`.

## H5 — the mock bites (the gate's own prescription)

At head `67c7c528c9`, the code under test reverted to its pre-objectui#10666 shape: `git apply -R` of PR objectui#10729's `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` hunk. On-disk proof: `queryFilter` 5 → 0, `useResolvedFilter` 3 → 0, `schema.filter` 5 → 7, blob `fbede2de83…` → `3c59cd6219…` (the pre-change blob git recorded), `1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 18 deletions(-)`. The sweep went red on exactly the map rows: `Tests 6 failed | 66 passed (72)` — `object-map (object)` and `object-map (inline)`, each on USER, ORG and REBUILD; every other row stayed green. Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- FILE`, blob `fbede2de83…` equal to HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty; the sweep then `Tests 72 passed (72)`. `@object-ui/plugin-map` resolves to `src/` through the root vitest alias, so this ablation has no `dist/` leg. The mutation script carried an EXIT/INT/TERM trap that restores the file.

No-install leg at head `67c7c528c9` (detached worktree, no `node_modules`): `check-vi-mock-specifiers` exit 0 — `OK (5622 tracked source file(s), 3794 test-named; 857 carry a mock; 1190 relative specifier(s) resolved, 1235 bare (out of scope), …)`, head's census, which the Gates table repeats: one relative specifier fewer and one bare more than the base tree's `1191`/`1234` in H1, which is this PR's one edit; `check-vi-mock-inherit` exit 0 (`884 inherit, 0 auto-mocked`). `check-vi-mock-override-shape` cannot run pre-install (it imports `typescript`: `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`), which is why `lint.yml` runs it after `pnpm install`; it is NOT MEASURED in that leg and green in the installed one below.

## Gates (installed worktree, tree equal to head `67c7c528c9`)

| gate | verdict |
|---|---|
| `check:vi-mock-specifiers` | exit 0 — `OK (5622 tracked source file(s) … 1190 relative specifier(s) resolved, 1235 bare (out of scope) …)` |
| `check:vi-mock-inherit` | exit 0 — `OK (… 884 call site(s) … 884 inherit, 0 auto-mocked …)` |
| `check:vi-mock-override-shape` | exit 0 — `OK (… 1883 override(s), 1199 judged …)` |
| the sweep file | `Tests 72 passed (72)`, exit 0 (the run after the ablation restore) |
| `check-changeset-presence` | exit 0 — `1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`; before the changeset it was exit 1 naming the test file, so the declaration is owed, not decorative |
| `check:control-bytes` | exit 0 — `OK (scanned 8921 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)` |
| `check:new-line-citations` | exit 0 — `of which resolve to their content: 0` |
| `check:unused-deps` | exit 0 — `Every gated declaration has a consumer in the package that declares it` (devDependencies are measured, not gated, by this script; react-map-gl in apps/console has no consumer the scan reads, since a vi.mock string is none of its specifier forms — the exit 0 says nothing about this declaration) |
| `check:phantom-deps` | exit 0 |
| `check:lockfile-integrity`, `check:lockfile-dedupe` | exit 0, exit 0 |
| `changeset:check`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-overwrite` | all exit 0 (`1 changeset(s) added, 0 modified, 0 deleted`) |
| `@object-ui/console` type-check | `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 with 0 errors AFTER `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...'` (34 tasks, 3m20s under the shared verify lock); `--listFiles` lists the sweep once. Before the build the same command reported 506 `TS2307`/`TS2882` on unbuilt workspace `dist/`, which is the unbuilt-tree class and not a reading. `tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force` exit 0. |
| eslint | `apps/console` `eslint .`: `0 errors, 218 warnings`, exit 0. The changed file carries the same single pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warning at base and at head. |

Gate derivation: objectui has no `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, so the list above was derived by hand from the root `package.json` scripts and `.github/workflows/` (the diff touches a console test, `apps/console/package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` and a changeset). NOT MEASURED locally, owned by CI: the repo-wide `pnpm lint` (turbo over every package) and the full test farm.

## Serial

- `origin/main` moved from the base `ee6f6c6a45` to `10e9cc6ae3` (39 files); none of the four files this PR touches is among them, so no merge commit was made.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD refs/…/main`: exit 0 (clean). `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD refs/…/pr-8941` (draft PR objectui#8941, `claude/pr-7058-lucide-react-1.41.0`, head `bb7d5e7187`): exit 0 (clean). objectui#8941 touches `apps/console/package.json` (the lucide-react range, four lines above in the same devDependencies block) and `pnpm-lock.yaml`; git merges them textually today. Whichever of the two lands second regenerates the lockfile with `pnpm install` and never hand-merges it.

## Acceptance notes

- The original comment's premise ("this app does not declare `react-map-gl`, so the bare specifier does not resolve from here") was accurate; the chosen remedy at the time made the mock depend on pnpm's on-disk layout and on the gate running post-install. Declaring the dependency where the test lives is the objectui#4409 dependency-direction method, the same reason the sweep lives in `apps/console` at all.
- `react-map-gl` is a devDependency of a published package (`@object-ui/console`); it is not installed by consumers and does not change `dist/` or `plugin.js`, so the changeset is empty on purpose.
- Observation, not filed (no reproduction of a defect): the pre-install checker's `tried 24 path(s)` message is exactly right for this class; the check itself needs no change.

The session behind this change is `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN` (`domain:ui` seat 2, dispatched dev, `mode:subagent`).
